Subject: Hiring calibration — anchors, scoring owners, and interview slice ownership

Team —

Thanks for carving time. We're moving Jordan Smith (Sr. Serving Engineer) to onsite next week and I want to lock the internal alignment so debriefs are fast and consistent. Goal of this thread: finalize (1) interview focal areas and anchors, (2) who owns scoring for each slice, and (3) who is the bar-raiser.

I uploaded a quick draft of the anchors and a condensed candidate brief (attached). Key asks:
- Review the anchor bullets and suggest one change per slice by EOD tomorrow.
- Confirm scoring ownership (example mapping in the doc).
- Nominate a bar-raiser (ideally someone not in the loop for day-to-day onboarding).

Draft slices (short):
- System design for LLM inference at scale (30m) — anchors: routing policy decisions, KV cache strategy, fallback handling under load.
- Model evaluation & trade-offs (20m) — anchors: latency vs quality trade, quantization impacts, A/B rollout plan.
- Reliability & observability (20m) — anchors: tracing, SLO ownership, incident playbook for model regressions.
- Culture/behavioral (30m) — anchors: mentoring, cross-team collaboration, customer empathy.

Attached: sr-serving-interview-anchors-v1.pdf, candidate-brief-jordan-smith.pdf

If we can settle owners today, I'll share an updated sheet and lock calendar invites.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Hiring Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Laura — thanks for the clear draft. A couple quick points: 

1) Bar-raiser: I'm happy to step in as bar-raiser for this role, assuming I can be on the debrief. I won't be on the interviews themselves; I prefer to watch for cross-team impact and hiring consistency.

2) System design anchors: add a sub-bullet to call out cold-start behavior for new model versions (we've seen gap there).

3) Scoring ownership proposal:
- System design: markus_klein
- Model eval & trade-offs: marissa_cole
- Reliability & observability: grace_oconnor
- Behavioral: laura_bennett

If that's acceptable, Marissa — can you take the model-eval anchors and add one example question around quantization trade-offs?

-Markus
